description: Find open jobs by role, skill or company, with an optional place, remote, and experience level. Results come from employers' own careers sites first (confirmed open in the last 3 days); when those are fewer than asked for, jobs from Internshala and Unstop fill the rest, each marked with its source. Each result has the employer's apply link, the stated pay and minimum years when the posting gives them, a two-line summary and the core skills.

country.description: A country name or its two-letter code, e.g. "IN", "US". Leave empty for every country.

level.description: intern, fresher (students, new graduates, up to a year), junior, mid, senior, or lead.

location.description: Where the job is, when the person names a place: a city, metro area, state or country, e.g. "Bengaluru", "Delhi NCR", "Maharashtra", "United States".

query.description: The role, skill or company, e.g. "full stack developer", "React", "data analyst", "Razorpay". It may also name a place ("in Pune") or say remote or fresher.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
